_comment: The launch roster: which MetaHuman becomes which companion.
`asset` is what Unreal opens. `name` is the character id this bake gets -- the folder,
the .glb filename and what the runtime calls it. They are allowed to differ, and here
`body` decides the animation library and is NOT derived from the name. It describes the
rig, and a wrong one ships silently as female whatever the character is (telegamez#3285).
Every value below was read back from the character's own manifest.json rather than
inferred from the person the name suggests.
Hair calibration follows the ASSET. Stage 03 embeds it into the sidecar keyed on the
asset's name, so a rename costs nothing -- see embed_hair_tuning.mjs.
Julius is Tele5, not Tele3. Tele3's MetaHumanCharacter has no head groom attached: stage
00 clears and rebuilds /Game/Unpacked/<Name> on every run, and its 2026-08-28 rebuild --
twelve days after that clear landed -- produced eyebrows and lashes and nothing else. The
Hair_S_Coil sitting in MetaHumans/Tele3/Grooms is not wired to the asset. Tele5 carries
Hair_S_Coil properly, with MI_WI_Hair_S_Coil_Hair and its cards material.
Tele5 renders with DEFAULT hair calibration, and unlike Kathy there is nothing to seed it
from: no character on the roster uses Hair_S_Coil. The tuned grooms are BobLayered x2,
TwistedBraids, SideSweptFringe, BobMessy x2 and SweptUp. Coil needs dialling in on screen
once, after which it belongs in hairProfile.ts keyed on tele5.
